description: This file contains unit tests for device health functions related to an OpenClaw managed matrix device system, verifying device name recognition and health status summarization.

methods.name: isOpenClawManagedMatrixDevice
methods.description: Determines if a device name belongs to an OpenClaw-managed matrix device.

methods.name: summarizeMatrixDeviceHealth
methods.description: Generates a summary of the health status of matrix devices, distinguishing current and stale devices.
